Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Edit the FIRST image: approved YouTube podcast thumbnail. SECOND image is a branding palette reference ONLY (use option B, bottom row): aubergine #511F58, vivid yellow #FFEC04, luminous natural faces. Do NOT copy its words, claims, dotted flat background, or portrait.
Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 thumbnail. Preserve exact camera, crop, body poses, eye direction, hand anatomy, clothes, all recognizable facial details and facial texture from the edit target. Keep subject coordinates and scale EXACTLY unchanged, this must align with original for pixel compositing. Do not redraw faces, smooth, sharpen or add pores. No magenta/purple tint on skin or clothing; faces neutrally lit, naturally separated from darker backdrop.
Brand treatment: richly photographic deep aubergine interior walls/shadows with elegant restrained warm practical lighting, retain real room depth, furniture, shelving, desk, defocus and materials. Aubergine must be visibly dominant in background, not near-black or bright magenta, but preserve the real room. Never replace interior with a flat gradient. No cyan circles, rings, artificial rim halos or new microphones.
Typography: exact original headline words; no invented claims. Put the specified KEY PHRASE in solid vivid #FFEC04 rectangular box with BLACK bold letters and subtle soft yellow glow. Other headline words stay WHITE. Preserve original headline placement and size as closely as possible, may fit typography to box, generous margins, do not cover eyes or faces. One key yellow box, crisp edges and clean mobile-readable type. No decorative underline competing with the new box. Keep existing YouTube logo if present.
Return a clean master with NO additional noise/grain (grain added once at final export), NO extra text or watermarks.
